confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Czech pricing and the town's tourist seasonality. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more with July peak demand. The cocktail and wine anchors were set from direct knowledge of local price levels, not from the beer-relationship fallback. FX observation taken from the RBA exchange-rates frequency page as surfaced in search; the RBA notes its data should not be relied on for regulatory or commercial purposes.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against smaller Czech tourist towns and Czech regional restaurant norms, with a tourism premium applied to lodging and central cafés. Český Krumlov runs below Prague on restaurants and drinks, but July peak demand pushes hotel and hostel rates up.
